answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 13368 Country: Bangladesh Title: Assalamulaikum Janab, Pls tell me with wearing a Half Shirt / Fotua , can I do Salah/Namaz? Allah Hafez. Question: Assalamulaikum Janab, Pls tell me with wearing a Half Shirt / Fotua , can I do Salah/Namaz? Allah Hafez. Answer ID: 13368 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 907/907=M/1430) Performing salah in clothing not suitable for a respectable Islamic meeting is makrooh. Half shirt also carries the same ruling; performing salah wearing the same is makrooh. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
